{{Quote|Dead...! An entire Rebel information retrieval team wiped out...! By someone who found this outpost ahead of us!|Darth Vader upon landing on Ultaar|<ref name="marvel21" />}}
'''Ultaar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]], covered in jungles of towering [[giant blossom]]s that covered the world with a thick scent. Ultaar was home to the four-armed [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Ultaarian Greenback]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Ultaar became host to a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance ]] presence, which was wiped out in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance]].

==Description==
[[File:VaderOnUltaar.jpg|thumb|left|200px||Darth Vader amidst the giant blossom forests of Ultaar]]
A [[Planet/Legends|planet]] covered in thick jungle,<ref name="doom">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin4|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 4|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 4}}</ref> Ultaar was located in the [[Ultaar system/Legends|Ultaar system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ultaar was covered in [[giant blossom]]s that locals grew for harvest, dominating the planet's skies and filling the air with a powerful, ripe scent.<ref name="marvel21" /> Ultaar was the home of a species of powerful four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] bipeds known as the [[Ultaarian Greenback]].<ref name="gladiator" />

==History==
During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Ultaar became the site of a small Rebel outpost. That was, until the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance]] came to the world seeking information on an unnamed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|young man]] who had aided in the Rebel [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] the [[0 BBY/Legends|previous year]]. Although the Rebels didn't know anything about the man's identity or location, one of them dared to draw a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on Valance&mdash;in response, the hunter viciously mowed down the entire Rebel cell, and moved along on his search. Not long after, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived on Ultaar with a complement of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], seeking the same information. Vader arrived to find the entire Rebel team slaughtered, save for one grievously wounded survivor. The lone remaining Rebel revealed what had happened in their encounter with Valance, before Vader put him out of his misery.<ref name="marvel21" />

While the episode was an instance of outsiders coming to Ultaar, in turn, some Ultaarian Greenbacks made their way offworld by the time of the Galactic Civil War. One Greenback<ref name="gladiator" />&mdash;referred to by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and Rebel hero [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as the "[[living windmill]]"&mdash;entered the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competition known as [[The Big Game]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. Wielding a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[dagger thorn]] in each hand, the Greenback met his end while fighting Solo, after accidentally pricking himself with his own venom-coated weapon.<ref name="marvel20">[[Star Wars (1977) 20|''Star Wars'' (1977) 20]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Ultaar first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 21|''Star Wars'' (1977) 21]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1978]]. In its sole appearance in the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel Comics ''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, Ultaar was illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]].<ref name="marvel21" />
